newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms buy 13,500T of copra from Toepfer.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms buy 13,500T of copra from Toepfer.

text.p: South Korean feed milling companies bought 13,500 tonnes of copra at $120.73 a tonne C&F from Toepfer through private negotiation, trade sources said on Thursday.
These companies include Cheiljedang Corp, Miwon Co Ltd, Woo Sung Feed Mill Co Ltd and Purina Korea Inc.
They said the purchase was comprised of 6,000 tonnes with shipment set for April and 7,500 tonnes to be shipped in May.
Arrival was set for the two ports of Inchon and Kunsan.
